name: low-credit-mode
description: A Codex skill for focused work when AI allowance is low, with optional validated budget calculations and early finalization.

interface.longDescription: Keep work focused when AI allowance is running low. Low Credit Mode prioritizes the essential result, checks a supported usage reader when available, and begins finalization early. An optional local helper validates quota snapshots and budget calculations. The skill works conservatively when readings are unavailable. Targets are best effort; live quota integration depends on the host, and savings are not guaranteed.
defaultPrompt: Use Low-credit mode to complete this task while conserving my remaining allowance.
